description: This file contains test cases for the 'Project' schema in a Perl-based application, utilizing Test2 framework, testing database interactions, memory cycles, and data retrieval methods related to projects.

methods.name: inventory
methods.description: Test subroutine that retrieves and verifies the inventory details of a project with ID 1.

methods.name: articles_cached_units
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the caching of article units, memory cycles, and related data manipulations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Test subroutine that deletes all project records and verifies that certain other tables remain unaffected.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Test subroutine that checks the 'stale' status of projects based on date criteria.

methods.name: find_or_create_tags_from_names
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies creation and retrieval of tags associated with a project.

methods.name: dishes
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the number of dishes associated with the project.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Test subroutine that verifies the number of items (meals) associated with the project.
